name: Elixir CI

on: [pull_request, push]

jobs:
  ci:
    name: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - elixir: "1.12.3"
            otp: "24.3.4"
            run_vendored_tests: true
          - elixir: "1.13.4"
            otp: "24.3.4"
          - elixir: "1.13.4"
            otp: "25.0.2"
          - elixir: "1.14.3"
            otp: "25.3.2"
          - elixir: "1.15.5"
            otp: "26.2.5"
          - elixir: "1.16.0"
            otp: "26.2.5"
          - elixir: "1.18.3"
            otp: "27.3.4"
          - elixir: "1.19.1"
            otp: "28.3.1"
          - elixir: "1.19.5"
            otp: "28.3.1"
            check_formatted: true
            run_credo: true
            run_coveralls: true
            run_dialyzer: true
          - elixir: "1.20.1"
            otp: "28.3.1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Elixir
        id: beam
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          elixir-version: ${{ matrix.elixir }}
          otp-version: ${{ matrix.otp }}
          version-type: strict

      - name: Restore dependencies cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: deps
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ matrix.elixir }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ matrix.elixir }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}
            ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ matrix.elixir }}-mix

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mix deps.get

      - name: Retrieve PLT Cache
        if: matrix.run_dialyzer
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: plt-cache
        with:
          path: priv/plts
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.beam.outputs.otp-version }}-${{ steps.beam.outputs.elixir-version }}-plts-${{ hashFiles(format('{0}{1}', github.workspace, '/mix.lock')) }}

      - name: Create PLTs
        if: matrix.run_dialyzer && steps.plt-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p priv/plts
          mix dialyzer.build

      - name: Check formatting
        run: mix format --check-formatted
        if: matrix.check_formatted

      - name: Run dialyzer
        run: mix dialyzer
        if: matrix.run_dialyzer

      - name: Run credo
        run: mix credo
        if: matrix.run_credo

      - name: Run tests
        run: mix test

      - name: Run vendored tests
        run: mix test test_vendored
        if: matrix.run_vendored_tests

      - name: Coveralls
        run: mix coveralls.github
        if: matrix.run_coveralls
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
